questions.markdown:
Find the Fourier series expansion of

$$
f(x)=
\begin{cases}
x+\dfrac{\pi}{2}, & -\pi<x<0\\
x-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, & 0<x<\pi
\end{cases}
$$

with $f(x+2\pi)=f(x)$.
Express $f(x)=2+x$ as a half-range sine series in $(0,2)$.

Obtain the Fourier series expansion of up to the second harmonics from the following table.

| $x$ | $0^\circ$ | $60^\circ$ | $120^\circ$ | $180^\circ$ | $240^\circ$ | $300^\circ$ | $360^\circ$ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| $y$ | 3 | 5 | 5.7 | 6.3 | 7.2 | 4.3 | 3 |

questions.markdown:
Find the Fourier cosine transform of the function

$$
f(x)=
\begin{cases}
4x, & 0<x<1\\
4-x, & 1<x<4\\
0, & x>4
\end{cases}
$$
Find the homogeneous system whose solution space $W$ is spanned by the set of vectors $\{(1,0,2,3),(2,3,1,4),(3,3,5,7)\}$.

questions.markdown:
Solve the following system of equations by LU decomposition method.

$$
\begin{aligned}
x+y+z&=1\\
4x+3y-z&=6\\
3x+5y+3z&=4
\end{aligned}
$$

Find the Cholesky decomposition of

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}
4 & 12 & -16\\
12 & 37 & -43\\
-16 & -43 & 98
\end{bmatrix}
$$

Find a singular value decomposition of

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}
4 & 0\\
3 & -5
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Let $W$ be the subspace of $\mathbb{R}^4$ spanned by the set of vectors $\{(1,2,0,1),(2,1,0,3),(3,1,2,4)\}$.

(i) Find a basis and the dimension of $W$.

(ii) Extend the basis of $W$ to a basis of $\mathbb{R}^4$.

Let $W_1, W_2$ be the subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^4$ given as

$$
W_1=\{(a,b,c,d)\,/\, b-2c+d=0\}
$$

and

$$
W_2=\{(a,b,c,d)\,/\, a=d,\, b=2c\}.
$$

Find a basis and the dimension of

(i) $W_1\cap W_2$  (ii) $W_1+W_2$.

Find a basis and the dimension of kernel and image of the linear map $T:\mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}^3$ given by $T(v)=Av$,

where

$$
A=\begin{pmatrix}
1 & 1 & 1\\
1 & -1 & 1\\
1 & 0 & 1
\end{pmatrix}
$$

and $v$ is a column vector of $\mathbb{R}^3$.

questions.markdown:
Find the matrix representation of the following linear operator $T$ on $\mathbb{R}^2$, defined as

$$
T(x,y)=(2x-7y,4x+3y),
$$

relative to the basis

$$
S=\{(1,3),(2,5)\}.
$$

Let $V=C[a,b]$ be the vector space of continuous functions with the inner product

$$
< f(t), g(t) >= \int_a^b f(t)g(t)\,dt.
$$

Determine the cosine of the angle between the functions

$$
f(t)=\cos t \text{ and } g(t)=\cos 2t
$$

in $[-\pi,\pi]$.
